02-welcome-pack.verdict: The e4 centred card is a real step toward the guide, but it still has an explaining paragraph, rarity-coloured names, a heavy 'Take the pack' button and a bare close button with no X; the e1 full-screen slab is the exact pattern the guide deletes.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The hub floor is a readable playground but not a polished AAA screen: station labels are oversized and equal-weight, there is no clear primary action, and the corner text, test-build joke caption and cramped footer ignore the style guide.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: the stash is now a bordered card with an x, but it is still a dense debug-style panel with no title, 11-13px text, two paragraphs of help and several competing lime boxes, so it reads as a tool and not a polished menu.
findings: P0 whole screen, hierarchy and header: Put 'stash' in 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 at the card's left, 24px from the edge, with '13 held' at 20px tx-2 beside it. Delete the version stamp and the xp line from the card. Hide or dim the 'the undercroft' backdrop title behind the scrim (.80).

P0 bottom half: hint rows, two help paragraphs, freebie bar, toast: Delete both help paragraphs and the 'drag a tile onto another to swap' line. Cut the freebie text to 'issued gear: pistol, 2 bandages, frag, plate'. Keep the legend as a single 14px footer line. Move the toast to a top-centre slot that auto-dismisses after 3s.

P0 lime accents: first-raid banner, freebie bar, 'take the freebie kit', loadout headers: Use lime only for the one primary: 'take the freebie kit' as a filled --acc button, 56px high with --acc-ink text, bottom-right. Make the first-raid banner a tx-2 line with no border, or remove it. Set body text to tx-1.

P1 text sizes throughout: Set every read label to at least 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking. Set section headers ('stash', 'loadout', 'backpack', 'tactical belt') to 20px f-cond 700. Reserve f-mono for table numbers only.

P1 right column: backpack, tactical belt, gun keys, item wheel: Use one 8px-grid cell size (56px pitch, 8px gap) for belt, gun keys and wheel. Show the backpack as two full rows with no clipping. Delete 'oc going up' and the stray 'guns' caption. Move gun keys and wheel into a tab or drawer, or a single 2-column block aligned to the pane's 24px padding.

05-sector-page.verdict: A full-bleed form slab with a huge empty brown banner, an unreadable tiny map, wrapped steppers and explanatory sentences everywhere, so it ignores the modal, header, type-scale and close-button rules and looks like a debug panel, not a shippable pre-raid screen.

06-terms.verdict: A tidy dark modal that obeys the palette, but every element sits at the same grey weight, the type is far below the 16/20px floor, and an explaining paragraph plus a duplicate toast clutter it, so it reads as a generic template and not a polished game screen.

07-party-coop.verdict: The party card is a dark centred modal that follows the guide's panel and sentence-case rules, but it is a wall of small explaining text with a centred title, no hero or primary action, a bottom-text Close button and a misplaced Join button, so it reads as a debug dialog rather than a polished menu.

08-shop.verdict: the subtitle is gone and the panels now run to the bottom with the buy button pinned, but the grid is still tiny tiles floating in a huge empty panel, the joke pill sits inside the card, and the header and footer are still not to spec.
findings: P0 grid panel, x 119-1307, y 190-1002: use a 6-column grid of tiles that stretch to fill the width (about 190px square) with 8px gutters. group them under small section labels (medical, ammo, gear) to fill the panel. close the detail pane gap by adding a 160px item art or icon at the top, or by moving the price block up under the stats.

P0 pill 'everything here works. cannot say the same for you.' (x 767-1153, y 975-1012): delete it. add the 72px footer row (y 952-1024) with a ghost 'back' button (56px high, B glyph) on the left and the 14px legend on the right. shorten both panels to end at y~940.

P1 header, x 1574-1807, y 67-125: keep one currency block: '900' at 20px tx-1 with 'credits' at 16px tx-2. move xp, stash and bag to the footer legend. put 24px between the block and the 48x48 X, and add the B glyph. title the window 'shop' at 32/700.

P1 tabs and double rule, x 119-1801, y 124-190: tabs at 20px f-cond 600 with 24px side padding, 48px high, a 3px lime underline, and one divider only. put the strip on the title row or directly under it, and drop the second rule.

P1 tile prices, x 284-1285, y 215-230: make prices tx-2 at 16px. use danger red for unaffordable prices only. show 'sold out' as a 16px tx-2 label with the tile at 40% opacity. keep lime for the focused tile border and the buy button.

09-craft.verdict: The craft grid is clean and readable, but the screen is a top-heavy template with a dead lower half, a cream detail card that clashes with the dark UI, and a header that collides and shows redundant currency.

10-hire.verdict: A tidy but generic grid, undermined by a loud red glitch banner that outranks everything, a washed-out cream detail panel with a disabled-looking Hire button, and duplicated currency and price data.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: A tidy but generic dark modal with no focal point: the title, two competing boxes and a pile of explanatory text all sit at similar weight, and the buttons look disabled and have no visible pad focus.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: A full-bleed dark slab with a flat, monotone list: it is tidy but generic, with tiny type, a muddy amber focus row, and several style-guide violations (the $ sign, explaining sentences, a toast over a modal, and a top-left close that is not a close icon).

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: A flat, text-heavy dark form with placeholder profanity on screen, disabled buttons that read as dead rectangles, a collision in the header currency block, and nothing to draw the eye, so it is far below the polish bar.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: A clean but generic dark modal with a mismatched centered title, two identical yellow buttons that flatten hierarchy, no visible pad focus, and a lot of dead space.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: A competent dark-panel template with a clear two-column layout, but the grid is a wall of near-identical tiles, the operator preview is dwarfed, and the header, footer and list clip or crowd, so it reads as a debug inventory and not a Fortnite-grade fashion screen.

18-settings-hub.verdict: The new settings screen is visually identical to the old one: the narrow 960px column still floats in a card with empty flanks, the 'send play data' link still sits in the tab strip, and the long description still dominates the bottom, so none of the earlier advice was applied.
findings: P0 overall card composition (card x 25-1895, content x 481-1439): Add a 280px left category nav (tabs stacked, 56px rows, lime bar on the active one) at x=49. Put the list in the middle at about 700px. Put a 480px detail pane on the right, and drop the bottom description block.

P0 description block (x 481-1439, y 793-995): Cut the copy to one line of 16px tx-2, 90 characters at most, or move it into a right-hand detail pane. Leave 24px padding under the text and keep it 24px clear of the footer rule at y=995.

P1 value controls (chevrons x=923 and x=1175, value x=1049): Right-align the group to the row padding (x≈1415) with a 240px value column. Use 24px chevrons in tx-2 and light them lime only on the focused row. Show the chevrons on the other rows at 40% opacity or hide them.
P1 list bottom (y~775-793): Snap scrolling to whole 56px rows. Add a 24px fade mask at the bottom edge. Start the scrollbar below the tab strip at y=166 as a 4px track in --ui-line-hi.

P1 tab strip (y=140) and 'send play data' (x~1300-1416): Use 20px tabs, 48px high, with 24px side padding. Add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends. Move 'send play data' into the footer as a ghost button or into the accessibility tab.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The raid HUD is functional but cluttered: five or six competing text panels, a keybind cheat sheet that stays open, duplicated tooltips and tiny dense type leave no clear focal point and no consistent panel language.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The new version is lower case, the ammo panel has a real hierarchy and the career HUD is a tidy list, but the HUD is still a pile of unrelated boxes: the cheat sheet is still always on, the minimap and run info are bulky, the zone label is clipped behind the stats, and the type is tiny.
findings: P0 controls cheat sheet (bottom centre, x492-902, y697-867): Hide it by default and show a single 'f1 controls' chip (16px tx-2) for the first 30s only. If it stays, use 16px text, 24px padding, an --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, with keys in tx-1 and actions in tx-2. Remove the grip glyph.

P0 right column (x1582-1902, y18-695): Merge the four rows into one panel with 16px tx-2 labels and right-aligned 20px tx-1 numbers, 8px row gap, 24px inset. Move the zone label under the minimap or into the top-centre HUD. Shrink the minimap to about 240px, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, inset 48px from the screen edge.

P1 run info panel (x1583-1902, y533-695) and extraction chip (y702-725): Give all section heads the same 16px tx-2 style, with the title at tx-1 and 20px. Use a hanging indent for wrapped contract lines, or truncate them with an ellipsis. Dock the extract chip 8px under the panel, flush to the same left edge. Inset the whole column 48px from the right edge.

P1 ammo panel (x1578-1910, y893-1052) and status tag (x1720-1905, y803-832): Put the 'b backpack' hint at 16px tx-2 in the bottom row, with the item count and value as a single 16px tx-2 right-aligned line. Make the status tag a tx-1 text on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and no amber. Keep 8px clearance above the panel and 48px from the right and bottom edges.

P1 current pillagers list (top left, x10-390, y152-258): Show it on tab only, or at 40% opacity. Use an --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 24px padding and a 28px row pitch. Make the title tx-1 at 16px, and mark your own row with the accent. Inset it 48px from the edge.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: The map is readable as a data dump, but labels collide with icons and with each other, the zone names are almost invisible, and the frame, header and HUD have no shared system, so it looks like a debug overlay rather than a polished AAA map.

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The backpack is a wide, mostly empty dark slab with tiny, low-contrast text and three lonely item slots, and it sits in a HUD cluttered with competing text blocks, so it looks like a debug panel rather than a AAA inventory.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: The pause card is slightly better because 'report a problem' now matches its sibling buttons and abandon is quieter, but it is still a flat stack of five equal-weight buttons with an oversized boxed X and no raid context.
findings: P1 button stack (settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new): Keep resume run and settings full width. Put report, feedback and what's new in one row of three 40px quiet text buttons, or a 2-column grid. Give them the same --ui-panel fill as the others. Add a 16px tx-2 'esc' key hint on resume. Draw focus as a 2px --acc outline.

P1 abandon run: Keep it as a 40px-high text button with a 1px --danger border at 50% opacity, or add a 1px --ui-line divider centred in the 24px gap above it. Show a --danger 2px focus outline. Confirm before abandoning.
P2 card header: title and close X: Shrink the X to 40px with a 2px glyph and no box until it is focused. Align the accent tab to the 40px content edge, 3px by 36px, or drop it.
P2 header content: Add one 16px tx-2 line under the title with time and location, e.g. 'sector 3 · 04:12'. Keep it to one line.
P2 background scrim: Use --scrim at .80 as specified, so the raid stays faintly visible. Optionally blur the backdrop 4px.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: The new settings window is a huge fix (the old one was a broken, empty header stuck at the bottom of a black screen), and it now reads as a real centred card with tabs, rows and focus. But the content is a narrow column with dead side space, the controls float far from their labels, and the bottom of the list and the footer are crowded and cut off.
findings: P1 row controls (chevron, value, chevron): Right-align the stepper group to the row's right padding (16px). Or cap the row at 900px at 1080 so the label-to-control gap is under 400px. Make the chevrons about 24px with a 48px hit area.

P1 list bottom edge / 'how much is out there' row: Size the list to a whole number of 56px rows (at 4K, 112px each) or add a 24px fade mask at the bottom. Widen the scrollbar to 6-8px, with a visible track, and inset it 8px from the panel edge.
P1 window layout / side margins: Keep the 900px-at-1080 measure but align the title, tabs and footer to the same column. Or fill the card with a left category nav and a right detail pane.

P1 detail pane (edit the words): Drop the repeated title and shrink the pane to one 16px tx-2 line. Replace the copy with something neutral like 'changes the in-game wording'. Align the pane's left padding with the row text at x=522.
P2 tab strip: Use 20px tabs with 24px side padding and a 3px underline. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row, or make it a ghost button, and add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

32-keys-window.verdict: Clean, consistent keybind window that follows the guide's panel, close X and sentence-case rules, but it is a flat wall of identical key boxes with weak focus, a dim modal and nothing that says this is Pillagers.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: The HUD works as a debug-style overlay but feels like a pile of mismatched panels: the minimap is clipped and overlaps a zone label, the contracts list is dense with tiny text, and the alert is duplicated three times.

35-kia-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card that mostly follows the shell (red title, one hero number, row of 4 stats, tile row, one primary), but the hero is a banned '$' figure, the secondary text is tiny and dim, and the item tiles are too small and confusingly placed above the number.

38-extracted-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card with a clear hero number and a single amber primary, but it's too crowded vertically, still uses '$' and several small explanatory lines, and its title, hero and chip rows compete.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: The What's new modal is now a centred card with a decent amber primary, but it is a wall of five run-on explaining paragraphs at one weight and size, while the world behind it leaks toasts, a hotbar and HUD that should be hidden or waiting.

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case, but it is unchanged from the last review: the empty body is centered, the prompt is a dim ring-and-text with no real focus state, and the small card is neither a proper dialog nor a window.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206 x 605-628): Make it a 56px-high primary button with fill #e6ff3d, text #11150a at 20px/700, min-width 200px, right-aligned 24px from the card edge. Or use tx-1 text with a 3px #e6ff3d underline and drop the ring.

P1 card body, 'no scores yet' (x≈906-1014, y≈534): Left-align it at x=714 in tx-2, 20px/400, 24px below the header. Add 3 dim placeholder rows at a 56px pitch ('1 ---', '2 ---', '3 ---') with 1px #2e3337 dividers.

P1 card structure (682-1238 x 412-667): Choose one. For a dialog, make it 480x240 with 24px padding. For a window, make it 90% wide and tall with a 56px header and a 72px footer holding the primary on the right.
P2 close X, top-right of card (1167-1215 x 430-476): Use a 1px #4a5257 border, a 20px close glyph in tx-2, and a 'B' glyph 8px to its left. Inset it 24px from the top and right edges.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (96-210 x 60-88): Set it in tx-2 at 70% opacity, or remove it. If kept, use 32px with a 36px lime tab above it, aligned to x=96.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: lower case and a few small cleanups are the only real gains; the HUD still sits in the screen corners with no safe-zone inset, and none of the earlier P0/P1 layout fixes (labels clear of the hotbar, flat vitals, one active hotbar slot, one run-goals title) were applied.
findings: P0 bottom-left vitals and hotbar (x≈24-535, y≈965-1068): Fix the bars at 360px wide (x=96-456), flat 10px, on --ui-line tracks. Set hp to --ok, stamina to --acc, armour to tx-2. Put 16px labels and values left of or above the bars. Start the hotbar at x≥570 with 24px clear. Inset the block 96px from the left and 54px from the bottom.
P0 top-left, 'f1 controls' (x≈22-135, y≈155-180) and the green terrain patch behind it: Make it a 16px tx-2 legend at x=96, y=1026 on a --scrim chip, or delete it. Keep every world label at x≥96.

P1 right 'run info / run goals' panel (x≈1582-1900, y≈348-495): Delete 'run info'. Use one 20px tx-1 'run goals' title with 16px tx-2 rows on a 32px pitch and right-aligned sp values. Add 24px padding, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and a 16px gap under the minimap. Make the caret a 48px close target.

P1 hotbar (x≈570-1555, y≈950-1060) and tooltip (x≈870-1050, y≈925-950): Give only the active slot a 2px --acc border on --ui-raised. Give all others a 1px --ui-line border with no tint. Drop the tooltip chip, or make it a 16px tx-2 legend. Set slot numbers and counts at 16px.

P1 bottom-right ammo panel (x≈1578-1910, y≈870-1020): Inset the panel to x=1824 (96px margin). Use a --ui-panel fill at 90% and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the name 20px tx-2 and keep 56px 800 for the 60. Make the lime tab 2px by 36px at the top.

52-arcade-run-over.verdict: The title is now bright and the sub-line is a quiet grey rather than competing lime, but the prompt is still small and dim, the stats row is still left-heavy and the card is still a small box with dead space at the bottom.
findings: P1 Footer prompt 'press any key', bottom-right: Set the text at 24px f-cond 700 in tx-1 #efe9dc. Make the glyph full --acc #e6ff3d at 28px. Put the prompt in a 72px footer row with 24px padding and centre it vertically.
P1 Hero 'score 0 sp': Put a 16px tx-2 'score' label above. Show '0' at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 with 'sp' at 20px tx-2 beside it. Move 'ended early -50%' directly under the hero as a 16px --warn line.

P1 Stats row (kills / extractions / deaths): Use equal columns across the 652px inner width. Set values at 24px f-cond 600 tx-1 and labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with +.04em tracking, at least 4.5:1 contrast. Add a fourth 'time' column, or centre each stat in its column.
P2 Card vertical rhythm: Use 24px title→hero, 24px hero→divider, 24px divider→stats and 32px stats→footer. Make the footer row 72px, with a 1px --ui-line divider above it if needed.
P2 Card size and backdrop: Darken the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80). Either enlarge the card to match the window card, or keep it compact with 32px padding, the 4px radius and an opaque --ui-panel fill.

57-title-2p-coop-picked.verdict: the title screen has a good dark column and one lime accent, but the orange gradient logo, a stacked error bar, a capitalised input value and tiny low-contrast labels make it read as an unfinished template rather than a polished screen.
findings: P0 name input field, 'PILLAGER': render the value lower case ('pillager') with text-transform lowercase and store it that way. Use the 56px row style: --ui-raised fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, a 'name' label above it at 16px tx-2, and a lime 2px focus border.

P0 popup-blocked error bar between the menu and 'saves': shorten it to 'popup blocked' with a ghost 'retry' button, or show it as a toast above the menu. Leave at least 24px between it and the mode list. Keep one lime fill per screen, so make retry a ghost button with a --danger border.

P1 'pillagers' logo and tagline: make the logo flat --tx-1 or flat --acc at 56px f-cond 800 with no gradient or shadow, or make it an actual art asset. Raise the tagline to tx-2 at 20px, or delete it.

P1 mode list rows (1 player … 2 player co-op (server)): make '1 player' the 56px lime --acc primary. Make the rest ghost rows. Give the focused row a --ui-raised fill plus a 3px lime left bar. Cut the demo variants or group them under 'more'. Use a 16px tag with 8px padding, or drop the disabled row.

P1 saves section (saves label, 'pillager new' row, input row): line the saves block up with the 558px column or make it a proper panel. Use a 16px label. Use tx-1 for the name and tx-2 for the stats. Make every control in the row 48px high with 8px gaps. Move 'change name' and 'create' into one ghost style.

59-raid-abandon-confirm.verdict: A clean, compact confirm card with a clear title and a sensible primary/danger pair, but it has no close X or pad glyphs, a loose layout, a dim card edge, and a leftover HUD ghosting through the scrim.

65-codex.verdict: A legible but sparse card grid that fills only the top third of the screen, leaving a huge dead void, with a weak title, a jammed header, and no visible focus state.

66-trophy-case.verdict: The trophy cards are tidy individually, but the screen is two-thirds empty, the grid orphans a single card on row two, nothing shows focus, and the header stats and toast are crude.

62-arcade-operator-menu.verdict: The operator menu is now a clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime primary row, an x, and a key-cap footer, but it floats in a flat black void and has no hero, so it still feels like a template dialog.
findings: P1 whole screen / backdrop: Show the attract frame or live world at about 55% brightness under rgba(6,7,8,.80). Add a faint marquee or scanline motif at 6-8% opacity behind the card.

P1 new party row: Drop the outer ring, or make it a 2px tx-1 outline at a 2px offset. Right-align an 'enter' key cap in the row, 24px from the edge. Keep the label at 20px f-cond 700 with 24px left padding.

P1 card hierarchy: Tighten it to about 480x300, or give it an identity element such as an 'operator' title at 32px f-cond 800 over a one-line state readout (for example the current party size) at 16px tx-2.
P2 exit demo row: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border, tx-1 text and a right-aligned 'esc' key cap. Optionally use a --danger text and border tint for exit.
P2 footer key legend: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Use 8px inside a group and 24px between groups. Keep the x and the esc hint, but make the hint a single entry.

61-raid-wheel-open.verdict: The wheel itself has a clear gold focus segment, but it is buried under a controls cheat-sheet that overlaps it, a minimap and contracts list that clip, and a dozen competing HUD panels with inconsistent type and no shared panel style.

58-coop-player2-window-title.verdict: the clutter is gone and the lime button now leads the screen, but the amber gradient title competes with it, the lower block is cramped and the type is off-scale.
findings: P1 title 'pillagers' (about 56px, amber gradient with drop shadow): Fill it flat --tx-1 #efe9dc with no gradient and no shadow, f-cond 800 at 56px. Leave lime to the button and the focused save row.

P1 button, 'player 2 window' label and saves block (y 511–735): Use an 8px grid: 24px between title block and button, 32px from button to saves. Move 'player 2 window' into a 16px tx-2 chip above the title or into the top-left, not under the button. Give the saves label a 16px tx-2 size with 8px below it.

P1 name row: 'pillager' input, 'change name', 'create a new save': Make the row 48px high with 16px labels at weight 600. Make the input a --ui-raised field with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a visible focus ring in lime. Fold the two actions into one 'new save' ghost button, or keep 'change name' only on the selected row.

P1 type scale across the page (tagline, 'saves', row values, hints, 'v0.0737'): Snap to 56/32/20/16/14. Make the tagline 20px --tx-2 #aaa498 with a --scrim panel or stronger vignette behind it. Make the row stats 16px tx-2. Keep the version at 14px, only in the footer.

P1 background art behind the menu column: Raise the --scrim to .80 across the centre, or put the menu column on a 560px-wide --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep the art visible at the edges only.

46-arcade-attract-how-to-play.verdict: The how-to-play card is a clean, readable two-column key table with a good lime tab and an all-lower-case layout, but almost none of the earlier fixes were applied: the prompt, the close button, the card width and the type sizes are unchanged, and the column headers got smaller.
findings: P1 footer prompt 'press any key' (x≈1204-1346, y≈843-866): Make it 20px f-cond 700 in --acc, or give it a 24px lime underline bar. Replace the radio dot with a 16px key glyph. Put it in a 72px footer row with a 1px --ui-line rule above, right edge at x=1346, and trim the dead space between the last table row and the footer to 24px.

P1 column headers 'keyboard' / 'controller' (x≈759 and x≈1053, y≈279): Set them to 16px f-cond 600, +.04em tracking, in --tx-2 (#aaa498 or brighter). Keep a 1px --ui-line rule below at 40px row height.

P1 close X (x≈1298-1346, y≈192-239): Either delete the X on this party screen, since any key continues, or use a 48x48 ghost button with a 24px glyph and a 16px 'b' hint to its left. Make the header row 56px with a 1px --ui-line rule below.
P1 card frame (x 541-1378, y 176-905): Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80). Either widen the card to about 1700px with row names at 24px, or keep it narrow with a fixed 24px padding on every side.
P2 row names and key caps (x≈573-1230, y 325-772): Set row names to 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1. Set keycaps to 20px/600 on --ui-raised with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 12px side padding.

37-raid-extracting-countdown.verdict: The HUD is overloaded: a controls cheat-sheet, contracts list, scoreboard, pickup toasts, and a backpack panel all compete at once, with mismatched type sizes, overlapping labels, and no clear first read.

77-haul-reveal-done.verdict: The end card has a sound shell with a teal title, one amber primary and a centred stack, but it is overloaded with five text tiers, a '$' hero that breaks the SP rule, and body text that is too small for a couch.

63-arcade-operator-new-party-armed.verdict: A clean, on-token dark card with sentence case, a correct top-right close and a clear armed-danger state, but it is a small generic dialog on a flat black void, with weak hierarchy among its rows, small muted text and no pad-focus treatment.
findings: P1 Backdrop: Bake the live world behind the card, dimmed to ~55%, with a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer. The card and its border then separate from the background.

P1 Confirm new party / Exit demo rows: Make the armed row a 56px ghost with a 1px --danger border, tx-1 text and a faint fill (#1e2225). Keep red only for the border and a small label. Put Exit demo as a lower-weight ghost with a 16px gap, or move it to a footer left of the primary.
P1 Helper line 'Clears tonight's best · New seed': Remove it, or fold it into the armed row as a 16px tx-2 right-aligned value ('Clears best, new seed'). Floor it at 16px and 4.5:1.
P2 Header: 'Operator' + 'Tonight: 0 runs': Set the subline to 20px tx-2 on the title baseline, as '0 runs tonight' in the muted count style, or drop it. Keep 16px minimum.
P2 Key hint strip: Use 16px tx-2 labels with 28px-high caps and equal 24px gaps. Swap in pad glyphs (A/B/D-pad) when the last input was a pad. Right-align the strip or place it on the bottom edge.

55-arcade-run-over-scored.verdict: The title is now brighter than the subline and the lime 'ended early' text is demoted to muted grey, so the card reads cleaner, but it is still a small, bare card with a weak hero and a dim bottom-right prompt.
findings: P1 Hero 'score 0 sp': Put a 16px tx-2 'score' label above a 56px f-cond 800 '0 sp'. For a zero run, either dim the number to tx-2 or replace the slot with a line such as 'no haul'.

P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right: Set it to 20px f-cond 700 in tx-1, with the actual device glyph (key cap or pad button) at 24px. Keep it bottom-right on a 24px margin and give the glyph a lime ring (--acc) as the single accent.
P1 Title 'run over': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 tx-1. Lengthen the top tab to 36px × 3px so it reads as deliberate, and add 8px between title and subline.
P2 Subline 'ended early -50%': Keep 'ended early' in tx-2 at 16px and colour only '-50%' in --warn (#f5b73b), so the warning stays apart from the lime accent.

P2 Stats row (kills, extractions, deaths): Use equal 217px columns on the 652px inner width. Set values to 24px tx-1 and labels to 16px tx-2 with 4px between them, or add a fourth stat such as 'time' so the row fills the width.

60-abandoned-card.verdict: The abandoned card now follows the shared end-card shell and finally has a hero number, but it is still small and timid, with a sub-minimum XP line, a leftover "$" and no close X or pad glyphs, so it falls short of ARC Raiders polish.

42-hub-pause-box.verdict: The pause card is now clean and reads in one pass: a single amber primary, ghost buttons and a danger-bordered exit. It is still cramped at the top and bottom, with a toast under the modal and no close button or pad hints, so it falls short of the style guide.

49-arcade-pause-box.verdict: The card is clean and consistent with the guide (one amber primary, ghost stack, red End run, X top-right), but it is still a plain button list with a tiny 400px-wide footprint, an unlit focus state, and a backdrop where the HUD and the How to play overlay still ghost through.
findings: P1 Backdrop (both shots): Hide the HUD and the How to play overlay while paused. Bake the world once at 55% brightness under rgba(6,7,8,.80). Remove the leftover SP, ammo and objective ghosts.

P1 Footer hint 'Esc Resume' (image 1, bottom right): Delete it, as image 2 did, and keep the card at about 516px high. If it stays, use a 28px cap around 'Esc' with 'Resume' at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, and swap to the B glyph on pad.

P1 Button stack focus state: Focused ghost row: 2px --acc border, --ui-raised fill, 3px left --acc bar. On End run the focus border is --danger. Capture one shot with focus on Settings and one on End run.

P1 Card scale and button type: Widen the card to 520px. Set button text to 20px f-cond 700 and the title to 32px. Keep the 56px buttons and give Resume a small pad glyph or icon on its left to add identity.
P2 End run button: Lighten the text to about #ef5a42 for at least 4.5:1 and keep the 1px --danger border. Keep the 48px gap above it.

56-arcade-attract-board-scored.verdict: The card is unchanged apart from the close X moving about 8px left and different background sprites, so the weak 'press any key' prompt, floating 'no scores yet' and corner wordmark are all still there.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206, 616): Centre it in a 56px footer row. Use a 28px key or pad-button glyph chip with a 1px #4a5257 border, then the label at 24-32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Make the lime dot the only accent in the row. Name the device's actual key or button.

P1 'no scores yet' at (960,534): Set it in tx-2 #aaa498, f-cond 600 20px. Left-align it at x=713 under the title with 16px spacing, or centre it vertically between the header row and the prompt row. Better, show a muted 56px '0 sp' hero number so the empty board looks designed.
P1 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (95,72): Replace it with a real logo lockup of about 160x48 at (96,54), or remove it and put a 56px f-cond 800 hero title above the card. Keep only one.
P2 Card shell, 558x255 at (681,412): Use 24px padding on all sides, a 56px header row, a body that fills the remaining space, and a 56px footer row holding the prompt. Make the height 240-280px.

P2 Close X, (1160-1206, 430-476): Remove it, since any key continues, or keep it as a 48x48 ghost X with a 'b' glyph chip, aligned to the right padding at x=1214 and vertically centred on the title baseline.

47-arcade-drop-controls-card.verdict: The controls card and the duplicate storm toasts are gone, so the screen reads as a plain in-raid HUD, but the HUD is crowded with mismatched panels, type sizes and styles, and the pad focus and hierarchy are unresolved.
findings: P1 Bottom-left vitals (24-526, 905-1068): Make all three bars 12px high with 8px gaps and the same 16px f-cond label inside the left edge. Use --ok for hp, a muted tx-2 fill for stamina, and one cool blue for armour. Align the right edges and fold the 'standing' pill into a 16px tx-2 tag above the stack.

P1 Top-right run info panel (1502-1902, 244-390): Put it in panel P (fill #16191b at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding). Set the title to 20px 700 tx-1 and 'run goals' to 16px tx-2. Use a 32px row pitch with rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Leave a 16px gap below the minimap and make the chevron 24px.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel (1577-1910, 868-1022): Use one panel style for every HUD block. Set the weapon name to 20px tx-2, the hero '60' to 56px 800 tx-1, and '/ 360' to 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Give the panel a 16px inset and a 5% margin that matches the other corners.

P1 Top-left 'f1 controls' hint (22-135, 155-180): Draw 'f1' as a 28px key cap with tx-1 text on --ui-panel, followed by 'controls' in 16px tx-2 on a panel backing. Make the 'blackout' tag, the top toast and this hint share one pill style with 4px radius, a 3px left bar and 16px text.

P1 Top-centre score block and extract line (880-1040, 0-135): Offset the card 24px from the top. Make the timer the 56px hero and 'sp' a 20px tx-2 line. Put the extract line inside the card as a 16px teal row. Move the toast to 72px below the card, and move the arrow to a screen-edge indicator.

48-arcade-hud-move-to-start.verdict: The in-raid HUD works as a functional tutorial overlay but looks like stacked, unrelated widgets: the controls panel buries the start prompt, and six different type sizes, mixed panel styles, and washed-out low-contrast text break the guide.
findings: P0 Whole screen hierarchy: How to play panel vs the 'Shield - Move to start' prompt: Shrink the panel to a 4-row essentials list or collapse it to a dismissible strip. Promote the start prompt to a 32px tx-1 centred line with a key cap ('WASD  Move to start'). Make the panel 70% opacity so the world and the prompt read first.

P1 Top-centre score block (Score / 0 SP / 9:46 / Extract 140m): Sit the block 24px below the top edge, SP at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, timer 20px tx-1, extract line 16px --extract on a 40px --ui-panel 90% chip. Drop the 'Score' label or move it to 16px tx-2.

P1 Bottom-left status stack (Standing, Armour 60, Stamina, HP 100): One bar component: 12px high, 320px wide, 8px gap, 16px tx-1 label left-aligned above or inside each bar. HP gets the only heavy treatment (24px number). Drop the 'Standing' tab or make it a 16px chip. Move the stack to the 5% margin.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel ('B / I backpack', Burst Carbine 24 / 144, 4 items $390): Use a 1px --ui-line-hi bordered panel with 24px padding, inset 5% from the edges. Ammo is the hero at 56px, weapon name 20px tx-2. Make the hint a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack'). Replace '$390' with 'Credits 390' or remove it.

P1 Run Info / Run goals panel (right, under the minimap): Merge to one 16px tx-2 label, 'Run goals'. Rows at 16px tx-1 with right-aligned SP values in tx-2, 8px gaps, 16px padding, 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill. Leave a 16px gap below the minimap.

53-arcade-extracted-bonus-initials.verdict: This is still a cluttered in-raid HUD, not the extracted/bonus/initials end card the filename promises, and the same extract message appears four times at four different sizes.
findings: P0 Whole screen vs. filename (extracted / bonus / initials): Capture the end state: hide the HUD, show a 720px centred card on rgba(6,7,8,.80), 32px --extract title, one 56px hero SP number, a 4-stat row, initials tiles, and one 56px --acc primary button.

P0 Extract messaging: centre banner card, 'hold [x] to extract' at ~48px, bottom 'extract in progress! b 28s left', left toast 'extract in progress!': Keep one centre prompt only. Delete the banner card, the toast and the bottom line. Show one 56px f-cond 800 --extract countdown ('28 s') with a 16px 'hold [x]' label under it. Remove the stray 'b'.

P1 Top-centre cluster: 'score / 0 sp / 9:51 / extraction 0m / arrow': One 56px hero (the extract timer while extracting, otherwise SP), with a 16px tx-2 'score' label. Fold the extraction distance and arrow into one element inside the panel. Give it 24px padding and a 5% top margin.

P1 Run info panel (right, ~1500-1900 x 245-390): Panel P: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 24px padding. One 20px tx-1 title, delete the duplicate 'run goals' line. Rows at 16px with 8px gaps, values right-aligned in tx-2. 16px gap below the minimap.

P1 Left toast stack (5 toasts, 20-430 x 600-775): Cap at 3 toasts, 40px high, 8px gap, 5% left margin. Remove the duplicates and the tip text. Use the danger colour only on the glyph, with tx-1 for the text.

54-arcade-initials-redrop.verdict: The HUD works as an in-raid overlay, but the same extraction event appears four times, the top-centre block is cramped and overlaps, and type sizes, tags and panel styles ignore the guide.
findings: P0 Extraction messaging (centre banner, top toast, left feed, bottom line): Keep one: a 56px hero countdown in --extract at top-centre ('25 s'), plus a 40px toast at most. Delete the left-feed copy, the bottom line and the 'Extraction 0m' label. Make the 25 s the only big number.

P0 Top-centre block: Score / 0 SP / 9:48 / Extraction 0m / arrow / '?' / toast / 'Warden' label: Move the toast to its own slot at y≈96 with 40px height and no overlap. Push the block in from the top by at least 24px. Drop the '?' and the arrow, or put them in the world. Raise the 'Score' label to 16px.

P1 Bottom-centre text: 'Extract in progress! C 25S left', '19 hostiles closing in': Write '25 s'. Remove the 'C'. Put the line on a 40px toast with a 4px danger bar, or drop it. Keep 16px of clear space above the hotbar tag.

P1 Bottom-left feed (Stronghold, Golden enemy, Spotted, Extract): Show at most 3 toasts, each 40px high with a 4px left bar. Use tx-1 text at 16px minimum and a --scrim fill. Remove info toasts that repeat the map state. Hide the grey ones after 3 s.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel: Make the ammo 56px f-cond 800 and the weapon name 20px tx-2. Change the key hint to a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack') at 16px in a footer. Replace '$390' with 'SP 390' or remove it. Shrink the panel to fit its content, with 24px padding.

64-arcade-board-seeded-night.verdict: The card is tidy and fully lower case, but it is still a small, near-empty box with a tiny grey subtitle and a dim prompt, and it ignores the near-full-screen centred-card rule.
findings: P1 card size (x681-1239, y400-680): Either keep it as a deliberate small ask dialog at a fixed 560x280 with the 8px-grid padding, or build a real leaderboard card with 5 rows of rank, name and sp, plus an empty state inside that frame. Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) so the map stops competing.
P1 subtitle 'seeded night · ayi6' (x713, y496): Set it to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498) with +.04em tracking, 8px under the title. Drop the seed, or show it as 'seeded night' only.

P1 'press any key' prompt (x1065-1206, y615-642): Set the text to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 (#efe9dc). Replace the dot with a 24px key chip showing the actual key or pad button. Right-align to the 24px padding line.
P1 'no scores yet' (x906-1013, y545): Left-align it to x713, or centre it in a body zone of y520-600. Use 20px tx-1 with an optional 16px tx-2 line below it.

P2 close x button (x1159-1207, y417-465): Make the glyph 20px tx-1 on a 40px hit area, with a 2px --acc border when focused. Align its top to the title cap line, with the right edge on the 24px padding line.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The new settings card is shorter, so it shows only 6 rows before the fade-out cut (the old one showed about 9). It trades usable content for centering, and it keeps the same weak hierarchy, a stray footer warning, and undersized type.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: The Extracted card follows the shell (teal title, dark panel, amber primary) but it is a stack of seven equal-weight centred bands, with a '$' hero that breaks the SP rule, a stray floating tile, and too many small text lines.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: The banner text is now bigger and shorter, and the clipped 'Gear' rows no longer peek out, but the modal is still a cramped scrolling list with wrapped labels, collided rows, and a sub-spec type scale.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: a clean, consistent dark settings card that is slightly better than before (lime arrows on the focused row, unfocused rows dimmed, footer hint aligned to the margin), but the lime focus is still faint, the whole panel is a narrow column in a mostly empty full-screen card, and the bottom fade is muddy.
findings: P1 overall layout, card vs content column: widen the list to about 1400px (or add a left category rail of 280px) and raise row text to the 20px body size. Align the left edge with the title at x=48.
P1 focused row 'render resolution': give the focused row a fill of at least #262c30 plus a 1px --acc outline, or enlarge the focused value to 24px. Keep the lime arrows.
P1 bottom of the list, 'sprint zoom-out' row: snap the viewport to whole rows (the list height a multiple of 66px) or add a clean 24px gradient mask to the panel colour, and show a scroll indicator.

P1 unfocused rows (labels and values): move the value control to the right edge, or put thin row dividers plus a fixed 200px value column nearer the label. Make arrows at least 20px with a 44px hit area.
P2 tab bar: set the inactive tab colour to tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, separate 'send play data' with a 1px divider or move it into the list, and add small lb and rb glyphs at the tab bar ends.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: the only visible change is that 'esc close' moved right to align with the card margin; the cramped table, tiny weak section headers, clipped 'locked' line and empty side space from the last review are all still there.
findings: P1 bottom of scroll area, 'locked: these keep their jobs' at y~925: add 24px bottom padding inside the scroll region, a 16px fade mask above the footer line at y~935, and set the text to 16px --tx-2 #aaa498. Make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi.

P1 section headers (move, fight, gear, world) vs row labels: headers at 16px --tx-2 with +.08em tracking and a 3x16px --acc tab on the left. Row labels 20px, weight 600, --tx-1. Add 24px above each group.

P1 all 16 key chips (ls, a, rt, d-left ...): idle chip: --ui-raised fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px text. Focused chip: 2px --acc outline, --acc text, scale 1.04 with bounce. Make sure one chip is focused in the screenshot.

P1 layout: content column x480-1430 in a 1870px card: either span the table x49-1870 with the scrollbar on the card edge, or put a left 40% pane with a pad diagram that highlights the selected button. Keep a 48px margin.

P2 row labels vs chips, for example 'previous gun (hold: zoom out)' ending x743, chip at x760: set a 24px minimum gap, or make the label column 300px wide. Move '(hold: zoom out)' into a 16px --tx-2 sub-label, or drop it.

01-title-mode-menu.verdict: The saves block now lines up with the 558px mode stack and the name field reads in lower case, but the screen still has too many stacked controls, the amber gradient logo clashes with the lime accent, and none of the earlier structural fixes (logo, tagline, server row, top-right buttons) were made.
findings: P1 mode stack, x 681-1239, y 413-693: Delete the server row and the tag. Collapse the two demos into one 'demos' row that opens a sub-list. Fill unfocused rows with --ui-panel and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the focus state a 3px lime left bar on --ui-raised, with a pad 'A' glyph. Keep the 56px row pitch.

P1 logo, x 800-1120, y 265-345: Make the logo flat --tx-1 #efe9dc at about 96px with a 2px dark offset. Delete the tagline or set it at 20px --tx-2. Leave 48px of space between the logo and the stack.

P1 saves block, x 681-1239, y 715-833: Collapse to one 48px row: 'pillager new · 0 raids · $900 · 0 xp', with the name in tx-1 and the stats in tx-2 at 20px, no lime outline, and no 'saves' label. Add a ghost 'switch save' button. Move name entry and 'create a new save' into a 'new save' modal.

P1 name field and buttons, x 681-1239, y 794-831: Remove from the title screen. If it stays, use a 48px high field with a 20px tx-2 'name' label, ghost buttons at 20px text, and a 2px lime focus border.

P1 top-right buttons, x 1611-1823, y 33-80: Keep only 'settings', as a 48px ghost button with 20px text and a --ui-line-hi border, anchored at x 96 from the right edge and y 48. Move fullscreen into settings.

44-title-from-character-select.verdict: The title screen has a clear lime primary button, but the orange-gold gradient logo fights it, the trophy toast overlaps and hides the key-hint legend, and there are capitals on screen, a stacked menu and a saves block with no clear structure.
findings: P0 bottom centre: trophy toast over key-hint legend: Move the toast to the top-centre or the bottom-right, at least 24px clear of the legend (e.g. y=96px). Or lift the legend 56px. Never overlap them.
P0 name field 'PILLAGER': Render the value with text-transform:lowercase and use 'pillager' as the default. Add a 16px tx-2 label 'name'.
P1 'pillagers' logo: Make the logo flat --tx-1 at 800 weight (~96px), or flat --acc. Remove the gradient and shadow so the lime '1 player' button is the only hot element.

P1 menu stack and saves block: Put the menu and saves in one centred 640px column on a 90% --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Use a 56px row pitch with 8px gaps. Give 'saves' a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 label with a 1px divider.
P1 menu content: Hide 'coming later' and group the demos under one 'demos' entry. Delete the duplicate stats line and keep it only in the save row. Aim for 3 to 4 visible actions.

90-legend-full.verdict: The new version only adds a superhot toggle row to the key legend and trims a few lines of copy; the legend is still a big, dense, tiny-text wall that sits over the middle of the playfield and fights with every HUD element.
findings: undefined key legend (centre panel, 735-1170 x 155-927): Split it into a 2-column card sized to content, max ~60% height, with a 32px title ('controls') and a 48px X plus an esc/B hint. Cut it to the ~12 essential bindings. Use --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding.

undefined legend text size and contrast: Set rows to 20px (minimum 16px). Key chips in tx-1 with a --ui-raised fill and 1px --ui-line. Descriptions in tx-2 at ≥4.5:1. Section heads at 16px with +.04em tracking in --acc or tx-1, not amber (--warn is for warnings only). Raise the fill to --scrim .80+ so the map does not show through.

undefined legend column alignment and new last row: Render the backtick as a key chip like the others. Add 1px --ui-line dividers on a 48px row pitch. Keep 8px grid spacing between sections. Move 'f1 hide' into a 16px footer legend with a pad glyph.

undefined HUD colour and weight consistency (pillagers list, run info, concealed tag, codex toast): Map every accent to a token: lime --acc for focus only, --warn for warnings, --extract for extraction. Pull the label out from behind the minimap or clip it cleanly. Cap the HUD to the 5-size scale. Dim or hide the legend's backdrop competition.

undefined run info panel (right, 1585-1900 x 305-445): Use one panel style (same title colour and size for both panels). 16px padding on all sides. Give each objective row a 32px pitch with the count right-aligned in tx-2. Make the chevron ≥24px.

92-settings-superhot-pane.verdict: The window shell is right (centred card, title top-left, X top-right), but the pane is a flat, same-weight list with a clipped row, a mixed-up tab strip and an explanation block, so it reads as an unfinished template.
findings: P0 list bottom edge, 'master volume' row and the detail pane above it: Clip the list at a whole row boundary (56px pitch) with 8px of padding above the detail pane. Remove the audio rows from the 'the raid' group. Add a visible scrollbar track 4px wide spanning the full list height, or a fade at the bottom edge.

P0 detail pane at bottom ('superhot mode / time only moves when you act. / key: `(left of 1)'): Show the description only for the focused row, as a single 16px tx-2 line. Move the key hint to a right-aligned keycap chip. Align the text to the row label x (499). Remove the title that repeats the focused row.

P1 row layout: label at x≈499, stepper arrows at x≈923 and x≈1175, values centred at x≈1049: Put the control block at x≈800–1100, or right-align it to the row edge (x=1420). Make the chevrons 24px, tx-2, with a lime fill on the focused row. Use 20px/600 for values and make the focused value lime.

P1 tab strip ('the raid / audio / controls / controller / display / accessibility' + 'send play data'): Move 'send play data' to the footer as a ghost button or into its own tab content. Set tabs at 20px/600 with 24px side padding and a 48px height. Add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

P1 window card (outer frame) and the centred 960px column: Either widen the list to max 900px with a 5% margin and add a left category rail, or keep the 960px column and drop the full-width dividers. Place the 36px lime top tab inside the header, aligned to the title, or delete it.

60-mapfirst-1p.verdict: the map now sits in a proper centred card with a header, an x, a footer cta and a muted palette, and it finally looks like the same game as the other menus, but some map labels still crowd or sit on icons and the contract rows are a little busy.
findings: P1 map labels: cache / strongbox / cache stack at the right edge, extract b, blast freezer: anchor each label 8px from its icon on a fixed side (above for pickups, right for extracts). Merge each crate stack into one 24px badge with a count. Move 'blast freezer · locked' 16px up so it clears 'extract b' (about 24px of gap). Give every label a 2px #0b0c0d halo.

P1 contracts panel rows: use a fixed 72px row with the name at 20px/600 #efe9dc, the reward at 16px #aaa498, and the bar at 4px with the count on the bar line, right-aligned to the same edge. Show 'holding' as an empty bar with no extra word. Add a 1px #2e3337 divider. Keep lime on the active bar and green on done.

P2 zone names: packing floor, chill row, the long dock, the sump, scrap line: set zone names to 16px/600 #aaa498 with +.04em tracking and a 2px halo, placed in a clear corner of each zone. Keep the teal 20px/700 extract names as the only loud labels. Pickup labels stay #efe9dc.

P2 hot ground label and warning glyph: set 'hot ground' in #efe9dc 16px/600 with a halo, above the ring, with the 'warn' glyph at 20px beside it. Shift the ring or the extract a label so the label is not inside the red tint, or give it a halo.

P2 header: 'cold storage', 'sector map', 'dawn · clear' and the x: align the 'sector map' baseline to the title baseline (8px gap). Set the 'dawn · clear' at 16px #aaa498. Make the x button 40px with a 1px #4a5257 border and a lime focus ring when the pad is on it.

91-snip-panel-raid.verdict: The lime frame, size tag and copy/save actions are clearer than before, but the whole HUD is still at full strength, the controls cheat-sheet still collides with the frame, and the selection is still washed in blue, so it reads as a debug overlay rather than a polished snip mode.
findings: P1 controls cheat-sheet (492-902, 697-867): Hide the sheet while snip mode is active. If it must stay, move it at least 16px clear of the frame (top ≥ 735), use 16px #aaa498 text on a 24px row pitch, and add 16px padding so no row is clipped.

P1 whole HUD (pillagers board, run info, minimap, hotbar, hp/stamina, ammo block, toasts): Fade all HUD to 25% opacity while snipping. Keep only the frame, the size tag and the actions. Show one toast at most.
P1 selection interior (520-1239, 300-719): Remove the blue fill and show the inside at 100%. Dim the outside with --scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)). Add 8px square corner handles on the 2px lime border.

P1 copy / save action box (942-1239, 728-802): Drop the outer box and keep the two buttons only. Use 20px 700 labels, 56px high, 16px below the frame, right-aligned to it. Make save transparent with a 1px #4a5257 border. Add a 2px lime focus ring with a 2px offset.
P2 size tag '720 x 420 px' (520-630, 264-292): Use the panel component: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 text. Sit it flush on the frame's top-left edge. Use '×'.

20-raid-hud-drop.verdict: the raid hud has too many competing text boxes and no clear first read: the kit bar and bottom-left bars are readable, but the top-right career corner collides with the minimap, tiny low-contrast type is scattered everywhere, and panel styles, capitals and amber/lime accents are inconsistent.
findings: P0 top-right: credits / xp / stash line, minimap, and the purple 'the long d…' label: put the career items in one panel (--ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi) in a vertical list with a 48px safe margin. move the minimap below it with 16px gap, inside the 5% margin. move the zone name out of the map or truncate it cleanly. use tx-1 for the values at 20px and tx-2 for labels at 16px.

P0 whole screen: panel language: use one panel P everywhere: fill --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding, no ticks. keep the 2px lime top tab only on the ammo panel as the star.

P1 capitals on screen: 'run Info', 'contract Item nearby' (centre toast and bottom-left), 'extraction c available': lower-case 'run info' and 'contract item nearby'. show each notice once, in a single toast stack at the bottom-left, and delete the centre duplicates.

P1 left-middle keys cheat sheet (wasd … f1 full list) and the explanatory toast 'gold glow marks the box': collapse the cheat sheet to a single 'f1 keys' hint at 14px in the footer and show the list only on demand. remove the explaining sentence. if kept, give it a 16px minimum size and 24px padding.

P1 bottom-right ammo panel: make 12 / 24 the only hero (56px, 800). set the weapon name to 20px tx-1 and the backpack hint to 16px tx-2 in the footer. use a solid panel fill. merge the cover state into the status row beside the 'standing' tag.

34-raid-downed-pickups.verdict: the downed plate is now a contained dark card and the career row is a vertical list, but the right column is a crowded stack where the pickup feed, run info, 'extraction available' and the 'concealed' tag overlap each other, and the timer is still not the hero.
findings: P0 right column: run info, pickup feed, 'extraction available', 'concealed · in cover' tag: stack the right column top to bottom with a fixed 16px gap and a 48px right margin: career list, minimap at about 240px tall, run info, then status. Move the pickup feed out of this column to a separate anchor (above the weapon panel, right-aligned). Give 'extraction available' its own 24px row and drop the concealed tag to its own row or into the weapon panel.

P0 top-right career list (credits / xp / stash / backpack): shrink rows to 32px with 16px label text, a 240px width, and tx-2 labels with tx-1 values. Hide world labels under HUD panels, or add a 1px dark outline and keep them at least 16px clear of the HUD.

P1 centre downed plate: 'down' at 32px --danger, the timer at 56px tx-1 as the one hero, one 8px --danger bar, then the prompt at 20px with [f] in a lime chip. Use 24px padding and 16px gaps. Give the plate the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius as the other panels.
P1 run info panel: cap it at 3 contract lines with 24px padding and 8px row gaps, and use tx-1 for names with tx-2 for counts. Keep colour only for status glyphs.

P1 left pickup feed, contract toast and world labels: keep one feed, right-aligned, 3 rows with a 32px row height and an 8px gap, and delete the left one. Use a face where lower-case 'l' and 'i' are distinct. Give world labels a 1px dark outline at tx-1 and a 16px minimum.

36-raid-low-health.verdict: the low-health state is still not urgent: hp 18 sits on an empty black bar with only a thin red outline added, while the clipped career stack, the cluttered key legend and the inconsistent hud panels are all unchanged.
findings: P0 hp bar, bottom left: fill 18% of the bar with --danger #e5482f at 20px tall, pulse it at 1.2s, add a 20% red edge vignette, and set 'hp 18' at 32px tx-1 above the bar with 8px clearance and no tab.

P1 top-right career stack (credits, xp, stash, backpack): move the cache text out of this column or clip it to its row with 16px of clearance. Narrow the rows to about 240px with 8px gaps, hide zero-value rows, and drop the duplicate backpack value. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 key legend, bottom centre: hide it after 30s or collapse it to a single 16px 'f1 keys' hint. If it stays, set the text to 16px, use --tx-2 or lighter for actions, and align the columns on an 8px grid.

P1 hud panels (pillagers list, run info, ammo card, extraction chip, concealed chip): use one panel P (--ui-panel 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding). Set titles to 16px tx-1 with no amber, body 16px minimum, and use lime only for focus. Give contract rows 8px spacing and 16px right padding.

P1 toasts, top centre and left: show one toast at a time, not both. Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 16px and drop the explanation. Remove the duplicate bottom-left chip. Use one toast style with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

51-arcade-alert-reinforcements.verdict: The HUD is still a pile of different-looking widgets: pillager reinforcements shows twice (top pill and left log), the left log is a stack of mismatched pills, and the score, minimap, vitals and ammo panels share no common panel, type scale or padding.
findings: P0 top-centre 'pillager reinforcements' pill plus left event log (both shots): Show a live alert only in the top card. Log only older events, max 3 rows. Delete 'machine has you in sight'. Remove the duplicate pill.

P0 left event log: rain / blackout, stronghold, golden enemy, pillager reinforcements: One row component: fixed 320px wide, 32px high, --ui-panel at 90%, 3px left bar (--warn for info, --danger for threat), 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, 8px gap between rows, max 3 rows with older ones fading out. Drop the info icons.

P1 top-right minimap + 'run info' panel: Drop 'run info'. Make 'run goals' a 16px tx-2 label, goal names 20px tx-1, rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Use 16px padding, a 1px --ui-line divider between rows, an 8px gap below the minimap and a 24px margin from the screen edge.
P1 top-centre score block (0 sp / 9:45 / extract 113m): One Panel P, 16px from the top, containing the 56px f-cond 800 timer, a 20px score and the 16px --extract line with the arrow attached to it.

P1 bottom-left vitals (standing, armour, stamina, hp): Three bars, each 20px high with 8px gaps. Put the 16px label inside the left edge and the value on the right. Use --ok for hp, --extract for stamina and a neutral for armour. Make 'standing' a plain 16px tx-2 label above the bars. Render the damage chip as a tx-1 number.

78-raid-pause-box-full-kit.verdict: a clean, readable pause card with a clear lime primary action and a red abandon, but it is a narrow, generic stack of identical buttons with a stray text box, not the near-full-screen centred card the guide calls for, and the scrim leaves the HUD behind it as muddy noise.
findings: P1 report a problem field: Group 'report a problem' and 'feedback' together as one row, or make it a 56px secondary button that opens a text box. If it stays an input, add a 1px --ui-line-hi border plus a label, raise the placeholder to --tx-2 (4.5:1 minimum), and centre it vertically.

P1 whole card (720-1200 x 238-842): If pause counts as a dialog, document it as an exception in the guide. Otherwise widen it, for example into a two-column layout with the run summary on one side (time, loot, objectives) and the buttons on the other.
P1 background scrim: Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) flat and blur the backdrop by 6-8px, or hide the HUD while the pause card is open.

P2 button stack: Show focus as a 3px lime left bar plus a --ui-raised fill on the focused row. Keep lime fill only for the primary. Move feedback and what's new into a quieter row of two 16px text links, and add a key hint (esc, or the pad button) to resume.
P2 title row: Align the accent tab to x=760 or put it flush on the card's left edge. Shrink the X to 40px with a --ui-line-hi border and a --tx-2 glyph, and bring it to full --tx-1 only on focus.
